task_text: 给定图片随以下声明流传："Photos show the aftermath of hundreds of fish having fallen from the sky in a remote Australian town."（声明日期：2023-03-09）。核查这张图片是否真的拍于声明所说的地点，并依据证据尽量查明它实际拍于哪里。引用所依据的来源，说明未能确定的内容。
task_text_en: The given image circulated with the following claim: "Photos show the aftermath of hundreds of fish having fallen from the sky in a remote Australian town." (claim date: 2023-03-09). Check whether the picture really shows the place the claim names, and find where it was actually taken, as far as the evidence allows. Cite the sources you rely on, and state what could not be determined.
claims: Photos show the aftermath of hundreds of fish having fallen from the sky in a remote Australian town.

requirements.text: 图片是否拍于声明所说的地点（与该地点的参考照片当面比对：建筑、地标、地形、标牌）
requirements.text_en: Whether the picture shows the place the claim names (compared with reference photos of that place: buildings, landmarks, terrain, signs)

requirements.text: 载有这张图片的来源说它实际拍于哪里
requirements.text_en: Where the sources that carry the picture say it was actually taken

requirements.text: 未能确定的内容与结论的适用范围
requirements.text_en: What could not be determined and the scope of the conclusion

required_evidence.description: 检索打开的、载有这张图片或该地点照片的页面

checks.note: 标注：Where and when was the photo taken? → China March 17, 2015 - Kaili Development Zone in Qiandongnan Prefecture, Guizhou Province.
